ios.desc:
Oolong is a budget and planning tool that helps you take control of your finances.

The app is designed to be simple and easy, taking just 5 minutes to set up... Just input your assets, liabilities, and recurring income, expenses and transfers, and Oolong will generate forward-looking balance sheets and income statements to give you a clear picture of how your money ebbs and flows.  

Armed with this knowledge, you can start to make informed decisions today that can positively improve your financial future!

Terms of Use: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/
Privacy Policy: https://bracket.ltd/privacy

Oolong is "serverless", no login or bank credentials needed and because your data stays on the device.

quotes.text:
Oolong is a "budget forecast" tool that helps you understand what "will happen" to your money, instead of just showing you what "already happened"...

I've been using the "Oolong methodology" (excel spreadsheet) to manage my money for over a decade. But I've been hearing from accountants, students, and funeral directors (lol!) that they use the Oolong app to:

- Figure out how much to allocate to savings/investments

- Plan major one-time purchases

- Figure out "how much apartment" to rent/buy

What's New in v2?

- Completely new design

- Balance Sheets and Income Statements

- Multiple Accounts

Freemium

Oolong is free for the first 3 accounts (assets/liabilities) and 7 plan items (incomes/transfers/expenses). An "In App Upgrade" can be purchased to unlock unlimited accounts and plan items, as well as remove ads.

I hope you find it useful~
